solutionSql:
WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         date_trunc('month', MIN(booked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS cohort_start
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id,
         date_trunc('month', booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS month_start
  FROM shipments
)
SELECT to_char(f.cohort_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS integer) AS cohort_size,
       CAST(COUNT(a.customer_id) AS integer) AS retained
FROM firsts AS f
LEFT JOIN activity AS a
  ON a.customer_id = f.customer_id
 AND a.month_start = f.cohort_start + interval '1 month'
GROUP BY f.cohort_start
ORDER BY f.cohort_start;
ambiguities: Customers with no shipments have no first shipment, so they are in no cohort. The revised text implies this but does not state it.
notes: Revised text: the following month is the calendar month after the cohort month, counting every status, which is how the query already worked. Casts: cohort_size and retained cast to integer (were bigint). Coverage: each named dataset returned one cohort (2025-12) with retained equal to cohort_size (6 in the sample). Every cohort member also booked in January, so the outputs cannot separate the next-month rule from a same-month rule (which would also return 6). The rule itself is not exercised by these datasets.
